exposure: thyroid function test (serum fT3, fT4, TSH)
cohort: 350 pregnant women from 13 weeks till 28 weeks period of gestation, with 40 in the GDM group and 40 in the non-GDM group
finding: The mean TFT values are significantly lower in women with GDM as compared to non-GDM women, and higher values of anti TPO antibody (thyroid autoantibody) were found in the GDM group.
mod_finding: There was a higher incidence of caesarean delivery in the GDM group.
